purpose: Component validation within full-source decomposition; does not add an application card or distinct application hypothesis count.
hypothesis: Exact planar face derivatives agree with independent central differences of polygon mass/moment integrals, and satisfy the source stationary-site ratio bound 162 on every declared positive-mass configuration. A shrinking corner cell makes the pinned Jacobian condition proxy grow at least 1000x without violating that weighted ratio bound.

input.generator: uniform square; symmetric three-plane strip and three-plane shrinking corner, epsilon=2^-k
input.directions: three coordinate directions, common intercept shift, eight seeded nonconstant integer directions

baseline: Pinned mass-Jacobian trace^2/determinant as a conditioning proxy; not a measured Newton solver or a convergence-rate replacement
judge: Exact Fraction face geometry versus separately clipped polygon integrals; exact weighted derivative ratio and exact 2x2 matrix conditioning proxy
failure: Any stated precondition, derivative tolerance, gauge invariance or weighted inequality failure; or corner condition proxy growth below 1000x
limits: Finite 2D synthetic component check, not proof of the general moment lemma, a Newton performance result, a new application discovery, or human specification review. No threshold adjustment after results.
